title: quirivelia frutescens
intro: Quirivelia frutescens, commonly known as "Wild Quinine" or "Sweet Woodruff", is a flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Quirivelia frutescens include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
